entities.summary: Luiz Fux is a Brazilian judge and former Chief Justice of the Supreme Federal Court. He is of Romanian Jewish descent, and the first Jewish Brazilian member of the Court. Fux was previously a justice of the Superior Court of Justice before assuming his position at the Supreme Court.
